note: Do not instantiate directly; use itasca.data.tensor module functions.

methods.name: extra
methods.description: Get the UDTensor extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Get the UDTensor group name in a given slot.

methods.name: group_remove
methods.signature: tensor.group_remove(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Remove from the given group from all group slots of the UDTensor. One argument of type string, giving the group name, is required. The return value is a bool which is True if the group was removed from any slot, otherwise False.

methods.name: groups
methods.description: Get a dictionary describing which groups this UDTensor is part of. The keys of the dictionary are the slot names and the values are the group names.

methods.name: in_group
methods.signature: tensor.in_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> bool
methods.description: Test if the UDTensor is part of a given group. If the optional argument slot is given, only that slot is searched. Otherwise, all group slots are searched.

methods.name: pos
methods.description: Get the current position of UDTensor.

methods.name: set_extra
methods.description: Set the UDTensor extra data in the given slot.

methods.name: set_group
methods.signature: tensor.set_group(group_name: str or int[, slot: str or int]) -> None
methods.description: Set the UDTensor group name in a given slot.

methods.name: set_value
methods.description: Get the current value of UDTensor.

methods.name: valid
methods.description: Returns True if this UDTensor is live.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Get the current value of UDTensor.
